fusions.name: Headsman's Sigil
fusions.desc: Strikes the target for 26 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Suppressed] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Falling Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps a conjured edge through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Edge on the Word
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hewing Construct
fusions.desc: Conjures a cleaving blade of arcana. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
